experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Time-resolved analysis of transcription and chromatin state identified transcriptional repression as the immediate response to Ikaros induction.

factor_value.evidence: inferred: Transcriptional repression preceded transcriptional activation by several hours, and was accompanied by a rapid loss of chromatin accessibility and reduced levels of H3K27ac particularly at enhancers.

technology_type.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
